meta.title: SceneNav AI — Cinematic LinkedIn Launch Film
meta.publishingContext: LinkedIn 16:9 feed; all essential claims are burned into the image for muted playback.

scenes.purpose: Create the signal-denied problem in a physical aerospace context while showing the SceneNav artifact within three seconds.
scenes.voiceover: When positioning signals disappear, the Earth does not. Every image retains structure — patterns, corners, geometry — waiting to be understood.
scenes.layout: Three.js Earth occupies the right two-thirds; left third holds the question and a small SceneNav diagnostic badge.
scenes.elements: Wireframe Earth, three satellites, cyan signal arcs that fragment, a thin orbital horizon, question typography.
scenes.animation: Earth turns 15 degrees over eight seconds; satellite arcs flicker out from 2.8 to 5.4 seconds; title sharpens from 14px blur while moving 36px upward.
scenes.lighting: Cold cyan rim and amber failure pinpoints.
scenes.transitionOut: The Earth grid magnifies through its cyan longitude lines into terrain contours.

scenes.purpose: Show why aerial imagery may look different while preserving visual evidence.
scenes.voiceover: SceneNav AI begins with two aerial views of the same terrain. Different altitude. Different orientation. Different moment in time. Yet visual evidence remains.
scenes.layout: Reference raster anchors lower-left; tilted query plane crosses from upper-right; scale/orientation rulers form leading lines between them.
scenes.elements: Two independent procedural terrain planes, altitude/orientation labels, vector arrows, visual-clues statement.
scenes.animation: Query plane rotates from minus 16 to minus 4 degrees while drifting down-left; reference plane resolves beneath it; labels travel along two diagonal rulers.
scenes.lighting: White raster edges with a contained cyan key light.
scenes.transitionOut: The two plane corners become a field of luminous detected points.

scenes.purpose: Explain feature detection, descriptor matching, and RANSAC without inventing measurements.
scenes.voiceover: ORB and SIFT locate distinctive keypoints. Candidate correspondences are tested, then RANSAC rejects outliers and retains a geometrically consistent set. This is image-space matching — not a claim of location.
scenes.layout: Aerial planes face each other on left and right; correspondence lines traverse the center; the method labels orbit a central verification reticle.
scenes.elements: Keypoint halos, cyan candidate lines, amber rejected paths, emerald retained paths, ORB/SIFT/RANSAC labels, methodology disclaimer.
scenes.animation: Keypoints radiate from salient terrain intersections; candidate paths scan in left-to-right; RANSAC sends rejected paths downward in amber before emerald inliers lock in.
scenes.camera: Subtle 3D tilt settles to a frontal scientific view.
scenes.lighting: Cyan laser lines against a navy vignette.
scenes.transitionOut: The surviving line lattice converges to four corners and expands into the reference raster.

scenes.purpose: Make the projective transformation and resulting image-space footprint legible.
scenes.voiceover: A homography maps the query plane into the reference raster. The result is a projected footprint: four corners, an estimated region, and the geometry that connects them.
scenes.layout: A tilted query quad starts center-right, morphs toward a large reference raster, then resolves as an illuminated polygon in the raster's upper third.
scenes.elements: Query quadrilateral, matrix notation H, reference raster grid, projected footprint with four numbered corners, pixel-coordinate disclaimer.
scenes.animation: Query corners travel on curved paths into the reference plane; the polygon draws clockwise; matrix rows collapse into a single H glyph then dissolve.
scenes.camera: Macro pull-back during the final footprint reveal.
scenes.lighting: Emerald footprint edges with cool-white corner flares.
scenes.transitionOut: Footprint corners scatter outward as five diagnostic instruments.

scenes.purpose: Represent reliability assessment as multiple inspectable technical dimensions and state the limitation prominently.
scenes.voiceover: Across scale, spatial dispersion, inlier consistency, and conditioning, the system evaluates match quality. Its confidence index is an uncalibrated heuristic — not a probability of correct geographical localization.
scenes.layout: Four radial instruments surround a central Reliability Assessment title; a full-width limitation strip is locked to the bottom safe area.
scenes.elements: Multi-scale rings, spatial dispersion map, inlier consistency bars, conditioning matrix, central heuristic label, disclaimer strip.
scenes.animation: The four instruments orbit in quarter turns then settle sequentially; their arcs fill with different rhythms; disclaimer draws in on a rigid baseline.
scenes.camera: Static analytical framing after a brief opening rotation.
scenes.lighting: Cyan instruments, restrained emerald acceptance accents, zero red alarm language.
scenes.transitionOut: Instrument arcs stretch horizontally and become pipeline rails.

scenes.purpose: Assemble the actual research workflow as a motion system rather than a static flowchart.
scenes.voiceover: Input imagery. Feature detection. Matching. RANSAC. Homography. Footprint estimation. Reliability assessment. Each stage preserves evidence for review.
scenes.layout: Seven modules travel along an elevated diagonal rail, with the active evidence pulse continuously advancing.
scenes.elements: Input imagery, feature detection, matching, RANSAC, homography, footprint estimation, reliability assessment modules; cyan evidence pulse.
scenes.animation: Modules rise from a lower-left vanishing point with 140ms staccato offsets; pulse transfers node-to-node, leaving a dim evidence trace.
scenes.camera: Rail accelerates toward the viewer and breaks into logo geometry.
scenes.lighting: High-contrast cyan rail with white text.
scenes.transitionOut: All modules fold into two converging diagonal vectors.

scenes.purpose: End with a clean research-prototype identity and a clear intellectual stance.
scenes.voiceover: SceneNav AI. A scene-aided navigation research prototype. Visual intelligence. Spatial understanding. Designed for careful investigation, not unsupported certainty.
scenes.layout: A cyan geometric mark and SceneNav AI wordmark sit on the optical center, with prototype descriptor and two-part tagline on a lower baseline.
scenes.elements: Geometric S mark, wordmark, descriptor, tagline, single expanding pulse, footer reading IMAGE-SPACE EVIDENCE.
scenes.animation: The two diagonal vectors converge to form the mark; wordmark resolves from tracking 0.2em to 0.04em; the final pulse fades by 64.2 seconds for a clean hold.
scenes.lighting: Cyan volumetric beam, cool-white wordmark, near-black field.
scenes.transitionOut: Hold to black after end frame.
